description.value: This cross-sectional study assessed regional cortical thickness and fractal dimension changes, and their cognitive correlates, in people with Alzheimer’s disease, frontotemporal dementia, and healthy controls using surface-based morphometry.

spans.text: In this study, we aimed at assessing the regional patterns of cortical thickness and fractal dimension changes in a cross-sectional cohort of patients with AD and FTD.

description.value: The study used a cross-sectional cohort design with Alzheimer’s disease, frontotemporal dementia, and healthy control groups.

spans.text: The present study is part of the Neuroimaging of Inflammation in MemoRy and Other Disorders (NIMROD) protocol [ 23 ].

name.value: fractal dimension group comparison: AD versus controls

definition.value: decreased fractal dimension in AD relative to controls

value: AD subjects had decreased fractal dimension relative to controls in regions encompassing the insula, posterior cingulate, pre- and postcentral gyri, with additional decreases in bilateral parahippocampal gyri.
The fractal dimension in disease-related regions was associated with the severity of cognitive impairment.

name.value: fractal dimension group comparison: FTD versus controls

definition.value: decreased fractal dimension in FTD relative to controls

value: FTD patients exhibited decreased fractal dimension relative to controls in regions encompassing the insula, posterior cingulate, pre- and postcentral gyri, with reduced values in the right postcentral gyrus.
FTD had reduced fractal dimension in the insula, middle and inferior frontal, orbitofrontal, and anterior cingulate gyri compared to controls.

name.value: fractal dimension comparison between AD and FTD

definition.value: decreased fractal dimension in FTD relative to AD

value: Relative to AD, FTD patients had decreased fractal dimension in bilateral orbitofrontal cortex, left anterior insula, and paracentral gyrus.
No significant reduction in fractal dimension was observed for AD in comparison to FTD.

name.value: fractal dimension correlate of memory impairment in AD

definition.value: vertex-wise correlation between fractal dimension and memory impairment in the AD group

value: Memory impairment was associated with reduced fractal dimension in bilateral insula, left superior temporal, and isthmus cingulate for AD.
Memory impairment in AD was associated with a reduction of fractal dimension in the left isthmus cingulate and superior temporal gyrus.

name.value: fractal dimension correlates of cognition in FTD

definition.value: vertex-wise correlations between fractal dimension and memory, language, and fluency impairment in the FTD group

spans.text: Correlational analyses between fractal dimension and cognition showed that these regions were particularly vulnerable with regards to memory and language impairment, especially in FTD.

value: Impaired memory, language, and fluency subscores for FTD were all associated with reduced fractal dimension in left insula, inferior temporal, and medial orbitofrontal gyri.
Impaired memory, language, and fluency in the FTD group were all related to reduced cortical complexity in the insula, orbitofrontal and anterior cingulate gyri.
